name: program-cue
description: Conference programme operations platform built as a React Router and Cloudflare Workers modular monolith.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:worker
scripts.test:worker: vitest run --config vitest.worker.config.ts && vitest run --config vitest.agent.config.ts
scripts.dev:e2e: node scripts/reset-e2e-state.mjs && npm run db:migrate:e2e && react-router dev --mode e2e
scripts.serve:e2e: node scripts/reset-e2e-state.mjs && npm run db:migrate:e2e && npm run build && node scripts/serve-e2e-worker.mjs
scripts.check: npm run test:config && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:scanner && python3 scripts/validate-migration.py && npm run recovery:drill && npm run openapi:check && npm run test:e2e
scripts.check:core: npm run test:config && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:scanner && npm run build && python3 scripts/validate-migration.py && npm run recovery:drill && npm run openapi:check
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:check && npm run deploy:secrets && npm run build && wrangler deploy -c build/server/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:scanner: npm run test:scanner && wrangler deploy -c scanner/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply program-cue-db --local -c wrangler.development.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:e2e: wrangler d1 migrations apply program-cue-db --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state -c wrangler.demo.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply program-cue-db --remote -c wrangler.jsonc
